description: pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs check_revocation_against_anchor (around line 348): verifies that crl.issuer matches anchor.subject, but does NOT verify that cert.tbs_certificate.issuer matches anchor.subject. OcspChecker::check_revocation_against_anchor correctly performs this check (ocsp.rs:225). A caller passing a cert issued by CA-B with an anchor for CA-A will receive Ok(()) (cert not found in CA-A's CRL) instead of an error indicating the wrong revocation source was used. In hard-fail revocation mode this silently passes a cert that should be checked against a different CRL.
title: CrlChecker::check_revocation_against_anchor omits cert.issuer == anchor.subject check
